content: निषद् €1 <ab>P.</ab> (निषीदति <ab>&c.</ab>) .²1 To sit down, lie, recline; उष्णालुः शिशिरे निषीदति तरोर्मूलालवाले शिखी <ls>V. 2. 23</ls>. .²2 To sink down, fail, be disappointed. .²3 To dwell. .²4 To suffer pain, be afflicted.
